entries.en: The reagent turned purple when it touched the sample.
entries.zh: 试剂接触样品时变成了紫色。

entries.en: The dog slavered as we carved the roast.
entries.zh: 我们切烤肉时，那条狗馋得直流口水。

entries.en: Her translation preserves the poem's metrical pattern.
entries.zh: 她的译文保留了这首诗的格律形式。

entries.en: He entreated his brother to stay another night.
entries.zh: 他恳求哥哥再住一晚。

entries.en: The divestiture left the company with two factories.
entries.zh: 资产剥离后，公司还剩两家工厂。

entries.en: Our phonetics class begins with listening exercises.
entries.zh: 我们的语音学课以听力练习开始。

entries.en: An overconfident goalkeeper left the net unguarded.
entries.zh: 过于自信的守门员让球门无人防守。

entries.en: I stopped reading when the article descended into drivel.
entries.zh: 文章变得胡言乱语后，我就不再读了。

entries.en: She challenged his chauvinistic assumption that women disliked engineering.
entries.zh: 她反驳了他认为女性不喜欢工程学的大男子主义看法。

entries.en: The subscript identifies which observation the formula refers to.
entries.zh: 下标标明公式指的是哪一次观测。

entries.en: His former allies denounced him as a turncoat.
entries.zh: 他从前的盟友谴责他是变节者。

entries.en: The cafe became a gathering place for the city's literati.
entries.zh: 这家咖啡馆成了城中文人的聚会场所。

entries.en: Layers of dust accreted on the unused shelves.
entries.zh: 闲置的架子上逐渐积起层层灰尘。

entries.en: The old curmudgeon complained even about the birdsong.
entries.zh: 那个脾气暴躁的老人连鸟鸣都要抱怨。

entries.en: The report describes efforts to stanch the bleeding.
entries.zh: 报告描述了止血的努力。

entries.en: The seeds remained in dormancy throughout the cold season.
entries.zh: 这些种子在整个寒冷季节一直处于休眠状态。

entries.en: One poor exam result did not make him a dunce.
entries.zh: 一次考试成绩差并不意味着他是笨学生。

entries.en: The mask had a broad nose and simian features.
entries.zh: 这副面具有宽鼻子和猿猴般的面部特征。

entries.en: The novel follows a mutineer stranded on an island.
entries.zh: 小说讲述了一名流落孤岛的叛变者的经历。

entries.en: An officious neighbor kept rearranging our decorations.
entries.zh: 一个爱管闲事的邻居不停地调整我们的装饰。

entries.en: The ribald jokes embarrassed several dinner guests.
entries.zh: 这些粗俗的笑话让几位晚宴客人感到尴尬。

entries.en: We systematized the records before moving the archive.
entries.zh: 搬迁档案馆前，我们把记录作了系统整理。

entries.en: The band played at a funereal pace.
entries.zh: 乐队以送葬般缓慢肃穆的节奏演奏。

entries.en: The machine perforates each sheet along one edge.
entries.zh: 机器沿着每张纸的一条边打孔。

entries.meaningZh: 浅尝辄止的业余爱好者
entries.en: He collected expensive paints but remained a dilettante.
entries.zh: 他收藏昂贵的颜料，却始终只是个浅尝辄止的业余爱好者。

entries.en: The contract calculates payments through capitation rather than individual visits.
entries.zh: 合同按人头而非单次就诊计算付款。

entries.en: The silversmith engraved a small bird on the cup.
entries.zh: 银匠在杯子上刻了一只小鸟。

entries.en: In the story, the coven meets beside a ruined tower.
entries.zh: 故事中，女巫们在一座废塔旁聚会。

entries.en: A foghorn sounded beyond the harbor wall.
entries.zh: 港口防波堤外响起了雾号声。

entries.en: They called her a prude because she disliked their rude jokes.
entries.zh: 因为她不喜欢他们粗俗的笑话，他们就说她是个过分拘谨的人。

entries.en: The dancer kept her ankles limber with gentle stretches.
entries.zh: 舞者通过轻柔拉伸保持脚踝柔韧。

entries.en: The director countermanded the order to close the gallery.
entries.zh: 馆长撤销了关闭展厅的命令。

entries.en: Their meetings retained a spirit of comity despite sharp disagreements.
entries.zh: 尽管分歧尖锐，他们的会议仍保持着友好礼让的氛围。

entries.en: The family history records that he died intestate.
entries.zh: 家族史记载他去世时没有立遗嘱。

entries.en: She crocheted a blue border around the blanket.
entries.zh: 她用钩针给毯子织了一圈蓝色花边。

entries.en: Our voluble guide talked throughout the boat trip.
entries.zh: 我们那位健谈的导游在整个乘船途中一直说个不停。

entries.en: The pianist was a gifted improviser with a playful style.
entries.zh: 这位钢琴家是一位风格俏皮的天才即兴演奏者。

entries.en: A polyglot helped the travelers explain their unusual request.
entries.zh: 一位通晓多种语言的人帮助旅客们说明了他们不寻常的请求。

entries.en: The students watched crystallization through the laboratory window.
entries.zh: 学生们透过实验室的窗户观察结晶过程。

entries.en: The play portrays a venal official who sells public favors.
entries.zh: 这部戏描绘了一个出卖公职便利的贪官。

entries.en: The historian examined how the community responded to apostasy.
entries.zh: 历史学家研究了这个群体如何应对叛教行为。

entries.en: The young sophisticate knew every fashionable restaurant in town.
entries.zh: 这位见多识广的年轻人熟悉城里所有时髦的餐厅。

entries.en: A gosling struggled to climb the muddy bank.
entries.zh: 一只小鹅费力地爬上泥泞的岸坡。

entries.en: The petals had a pale color and a satiny surface.
entries.zh: 花瓣颜色淡雅，表面像缎子一样光滑。

entries.en: He admitted that jealousy was an ignoble motive.
entries.zh: 他承认嫉妒是一种卑鄙的动机。

entries.en: The exhibition includes a rough lump of bauxite.
entries.zh: 展览中有一块粗糙的铝土矿。

entries.en: Repeated rehearsals habituated the horses to the sound of drums.
entries.zh: 反复排练让马匹习惯了鼓声。

entries.en: Her interest in histology began with a microscope demonstration.
entries.zh: 一次显微镜演示让她开始对组织学感兴趣。

entries.en: Vernal sunshine warmed the empty garden benches.
entries.zh: 春日阳光照暖了花园里空着的长椅。

entries.en: Critics considered that performance the acme of her career.
entries.zh: 评论家认为那场表演是她职业生涯的顶峰。

entries.en: The artist painted the couple beneath a nuptial arch.
entries.zh: 画家把这对新人画在婚礼拱门下。

entries.en: A curvaceous glass vase stood in the window.
entries.zh: 窗边摆着一只曲线优美的玻璃花瓶。

entries.en: His imitation sent the audience into a paroxysm of laughter.
entries.zh: 他的模仿让观众突然爆发出一阵大笑。

entries.en: Their quick repartee kept the panel discussion lively.
entries.zh: 他们机敏的对答使小组讨论保持活跃。

entries.en: His ingratiating smile disappeared when the request was refused.
entries.zh: 请求被拒绝后，他讨好的笑容消失了。

entries.en: The first rehearsal disabused us of any notion that acting was easy.
entries.zh: 第一次排练打消了我们认为表演很容易的想法。

entries.en: The company staged a cheerful operetta about mistaken identities.
entries.zh: 剧团上演了一部讲述身份误认的欢乐轻歌剧。

entries.en: The assessment included questions about continence and mobility.
entries.zh: 评估包括有关大小便控制能力和行动能力的问题。

entries.en: The essay contrasts egoism with concern for strangers.
entries.zh: 这篇文章将利己主义与对陌生人的关心作了对比。

entries.en: The press lionized the young inventor after the exhibition.
entries.zh: 展览结束后，媒体把这位年轻发明家捧成了名人。

entries.en: One well-timed witticism broke the tension in the room.
entries.zh: 一句时机恰当的妙语缓解了房间里的紧张气氛。

entries.en: The documentary features a family living with hemophilia.
entries.zh: 这部纪录片讲述了一个受血友病影响的家庭。

entries.en: The usually loquacious host fell silent at the announcement.
entries.zh: 平时健谈的主持人听到宣布后沉默了。

entries.en: The novel's narrator is a prig who judges everyone harshly.
entries.zh: 这部小说的叙述者是个苛刻评判所有人的自命清高者。

entries.en: To her mortification, the microphone was still on.
entries.zh: 令她窘迫的是，麦克风仍然开着。

entries.en: The old thermometer displayed the temperature in Fahrenheit degrees.
entries.zh: 这支旧温度计以华氏度显示温度。

entries.en: A bassoon added a warm low note to the melody.
entries.zh: 一支巴松管为旋律增添了温暖的低音。

entries.en: The portrait shows a child with cherubic cheeks.
entries.zh: 肖像画中的孩子有着天使般可爱的脸颊。

entries.en: She navigated the unfamiliar streets with preternatural confidence.
entries.zh: 她以异乎寻常的自信穿行于陌生街道。

entries.en: The detective novel reveals the strangler's identity in its final chapter.
entries.zh: 这部侦探小说在最后一章揭示了勒人凶手的身份。

entries.en: His impudent reply earned a stern look from the librarian.
entries.zh: 他无礼的回答招来了图书管理员严厉的一瞥。

entries.en: The diagram tracks a recessive trait across three generations.
entries.zh: 这张图追踪了一种隐性性状在三代人中的传承。

entries.en: The specter of closure hung over the small theater.
entries.zh: 倒闭的阴影笼罩着这家小剧院。

entries.en: Her gift of gab made long train journeys entertaining.
entries.zh: 她的健谈本领让漫长的火车旅途变得有趣。

entries.en: The review criticized the documentary's tendentious selection of interviews.
entries.zh: 评论批评了纪录片对访谈内容有偏见的选取。

entries.en: The puppy slobbered all over my clean sleeve.
entries.zh: 小狗把口水流得我干净的袖子上到处都是。

entries.en: After dinner, our reserved host began to unbend.
entries.zh: 晚饭后，我们矜持的主人开始放松下来。

entries.en: She matriculated at the university the following autumn.
entries.zh: 次年秋天，她在那所大学注册入学。

entries.en: The lecture explained how feedback contributes to homeostasis.
entries.zh: 讲座解释了反馈如何有助于维持内稳态。

entries.en: The team compared two dynamical models of the pendulum.
entries.zh: 团队比较了两个摆的动力学模型。

entries.en: The false accusation threatened to besmirch her reputation.
entries.zh: 这项虚假指控可能玷污她的名誉。

entries.en: My feet are too ticklish for that game.
entries.zh: 我的脚太怕痒，玩不了那个游戏。

entries.en: The satire depicts an effete aristocracy unable to govern.
entries.zh: 这部讽刺作品描绘了无力治理的衰弱贵族阶层。

entries.en: The curator hoped the exhibition would edify as well as entertain.
entries.zh: 策展人希望展览既能娱乐观众，又能启迪他们。

entries.en: The textbook illustrates the structure of a mucous membrane.
entries.zh: 课本用图展示了黏膜的结构。

entries.en: Without regular practice, he began to backslide into sloppy habits.
entries.zh: 缺乏定期练习后，他又开始恢复马虎的习惯。

entries.en: One anomalous datum changed the shape of the graph.
entries.zh: 一个异常数据改变了图形的形状。

entries.en: The chapters cohere around a single central question.
entries.zh: 各章围绕一个核心问题连贯地组织起来。

entries.en: The opening chapter is expository rather than dramatic.
entries.zh: 开篇一章是说明性的，而不是戏剧性的。

entries.en: Evening light transfigured the ordinary buildings into golden silhouettes.
entries.zh: 暮光将普通的建筑变成了金色的轮廓。

entries.en: The sailors caroused at the inn until midnight.
entries.zh: 水手们在客栈饮酒作乐直到午夜。

entries.en: A dissonant chord interrupted the gentle melody.
entries.zh: 一个不协和的和弦打断了柔和的旋律。

entries.en: The choir rehearsed a cantata for the spring concert.
entries.zh: 合唱团为春季音乐会排练了一部康塔塔。

entries.en: She answered our basic questions without condescending to us.
entries.zh: 她回答了我们的基础问题，却没有居高临下地对待我们。

entries.en: The questionnaire listed flatulence among the reported symptoms.
entries.zh: 问卷将肠胃胀气列为所报告的症状之一。

entries.en: The painting depicts a corpulent merchant in a velvet coat.
entries.zh: 画中是一位穿天鹅绒外套的肥胖商人。

entries.en: Several visitors paused to genuflect before the altar.
entries.zh: 几位访客停下来在祭坛前屈膝行礼。

entries.en: A deep lassitude settled over us after the long journey.
entries.zh: 长途旅行后，我们感到深深的倦怠。

entries.en: Billowy curtains moved in the open window.
entries.zh: 波浪般起伏的窗帘在敞开的窗边飘动。

entries.en: The abandoned quarry had despoiled a once beautiful hillside.
entries.zh: 废弃的采石场毁坏了曾经美丽的山坡。

entries.en: He looked abashed when everyone noticed his mistake.
entries.zh: 大家都发现他的错误时，他显得很窘迫。

entries.en: The witness denied that she had perjured herself.
entries.zh: 证人否认自己作过伪证。

entries.en: The inelastic cord would not stretch around the parcel.
entries.zh: 这根缺乏弹性的绳子无法拉长绕住包裹。

entries.en: A lackadaisical rehearsal left the cast poorly prepared.
entries.zh: 一次漫不经心的排练让演员们准备不足。

entries.en: The crew discovered a stowaway behind the cargo crates.
entries.zh: 船员在货箱后发现了一名偷乘者。

entries.en: Years of wind had abraded the stone inscription.
entries.zh: 多年的风蚀磨损了石刻铭文。

entries.en: The survey asked whether respondents had gainful employment.
entries.zh: 调查询问受访者是否有有报酬的工作。

entries.en: The novel condemns the profiteers who exploited the shortage.
entries.zh: 小说谴责了利用物资短缺牟取暴利的人。

entries.en: The slogan's alliteration made it easy to remember.
entries.zh: 这个口号的头韵使它容易记住。

entries.en: The library acquired a collection of early ethnology journals.
entries.zh: 图书馆购入了一批早期民族学期刊。

entries.en: The investigation found that smoke had asphyxiated the trapped animals.
entries.zh: 调查发现，烟雾使被困动物窒息。

entries.en: A tiny pencil sharpener rattled inside her bag.
entries.zh: 一个小卷笔刀在她包里咔嗒作响。

entries.en: The portrait presents the potentate surrounded by elaborate symbols of power.
entries.zh: 肖像画展现了被繁复权力象征包围的统治者。

entries.en: The gardener photographed the canker on the apple tree.
entries.zh: 园丁拍下了苹果树上的溃疡病斑。

entries.en: The archive stores its oldest manuscripts in fireproof cabinets.
entries.zh: 档案馆把最古老的手稿存放在防火柜里。

entries.en: Air slowly distended the thin rubber bladder.
entries.zh: 空气使薄橡胶囊逐渐膨胀。

entries.en: The lamp cast a penumbra around the object's darker shadow.
entries.zh: 灯光在物体较深的阴影周围投下了半影。

entries.en: We cut the verbiage until the instructions fit on one page.
entries.zh: 我们删去冗词赘语，直到说明能放进一页纸。

entries.en: The supposed simpleton solved the mystery before anyone else.
entries.zh: 那个被认为是笨蛋的人比所有人都先解开了谜团。

entries.en: Old maps awakened her wanderlust on rainy afternoons.
entries.zh: 在下雨的午后，旧地图唤起了她的旅行欲。

entries.en: The manager found his assistant's obsequious praise uncomfortable.
entries.zh: 经理觉得助理谄媚的赞美令人不自在。

entries.en: The room was clean but otherwise unexceptional.
entries.zh: 房间很干净，除此之外并无特别之处。

entries.en: The little shop purveys handmade soaps and candles.
entries.zh: 这家小店供应手工肥皂和蜡烛。

entries.en: She showed magnanimity by congratulating the rival who had defeated her.
entries.zh: 她向击败自己的对手表示祝贺，展现了宽宏大量。

entries.en: The register lists the officeholder's annual emoluments.
entries.zh: 登记册列出了任职者的年度薪酬。

entries.en: The adaptation avoids slavish imitation of the original film.
entries.zh: 这部改编作品避免了对原电影的盲目模仿。

entries.en: To his vexation, the key broke in the lock.
entries.zh: 令他恼怒的是，钥匙断在锁里了。

entries.en: The experiment reminded us of the fallibility of memory.
entries.zh: 实验提醒我们记忆是容易出错的。

entries.en: The museum had to retrench after losing a major grant.
entries.zh: 失去一笔主要资助后，博物馆不得不削减开支。

entries.en: The simpler model appealed to her preference for parsimony.
entries.zh: 较简单的模型符合她对简约性的偏好。

entries.en: He greeted the approaching deadline with remarkable insouciance.
entries.zh: 他以惊人的漫不经心面对日益临近的截止日期。

entries.en: The illustration compares porcine and bovine anatomy.
entries.zh: 插图比较了猪和牛的解剖结构。

entries.en: The paper discusses the prognostic value of the measurement.
entries.zh: 论文讨论了这项测量的预后价值。

entries.en: Officials stonewalled when reporters asked about the missing documents.
entries.zh: 记者问及丢失文件时，官员们拒绝配合。

entries.en: Travel challenged the insularity of his early upbringing.
entries.zh: 旅行冲击了他早年成长环境中的封闭狭隘。

entries.en: The investigation uncovered years of accounting chicanery.
entries.zh: 调查揭露了多年的会计欺诈行为。

entries.en: The spell disembodied the wizard, leaving only his voice.
entries.zh: 咒语使巫师脱离肉身，只剩下他的声音。

entries.en: The opening pages limn a village on the brink of change.
entries.zh: 开篇几页描绘了一个即将发生变化的村庄。

entries.en: A narrow path ran beneath the rocky scarp.
entries.zh: 一条窄路从岩石陡崖下经过。

entries.en: His unctuous welcome made the visitors distrust him.
entries.zh: 他虚情假意的欢迎让访客们不信任他。

entries.en: The interviewer interrupted the actor's smarmy compliments.
entries.zh: 采访者打断了演员谄媚的恭维。

entries.en: He was apoplectic when the repaired roof leaked again.
entries.zh: 修好的屋顶再次漏水时，他暴跳如雷。

entries.en: The diagram labels the resistor's value in ohms.
entries.zh: 图中用欧姆标注电阻器的阻值。

entries.en: The speaker faced a fusillade of questions about the delay.
entries.zh: 发言者面对一连串关于延误的问题。

entries.en: Her gymnastic training helped her balance on the narrow beam.
entries.zh: 体操训练帮助她在窄横梁上保持平衡。

entries.en: The chapter examines village life under serfdom.
entries.zh: 这一章研究了农奴制下的村庄生活。

entries.en: Low clouds scudded across the moonlit sky.
entries.zh: 低云飞掠过月光下的天空。

entries.en: The heir was a spendthrift who emptied the family coffers.
entries.zh: 这个继承人是个挥霍者，花光了家产。

entries.en: A small electric motor actuates the lifting mechanism.
entries.zh: 一台小电动机驱动升降机构。

entries.en: The colloquium ended with a lively discussion of the findings.
entries.zh: 学术讨论会以对研究结果的热烈讨论结束。

entries.en: The annual jamboree filled the park with music and tents.
entries.zh: 一年一度的大型集会让公园里满是音乐和帐篷。

entries.en: His histrionic reaction distracted everyone from the small mistake.
entries.zh: 他矫揉造作的反应转移了所有人对那个小错误的注意。

entries.en: The side door provides an additional means of egress.
entries.zh: 侧门提供了额外的出口。

entries.en: Their quiet colloquy continued after the other guests left.
entries.zh: 其他客人离开后，他们仍在轻声交谈。

entries.en: Her ingenuous question exposed a flaw in the elaborate plan.
entries.zh: 她天真坦率的提问暴露了复杂计划中的一个缺陷。

entries.en: The quartet played a minuet while the guests arrived.
entries.zh: 宾客到来时，四重奏乐队演奏了一首小步舞曲。

entries.en: A research assistantship helped her cover university expenses.
entries.zh: 一个助研职位帮助她支付了大学开支。

entries.en: The fake invitation hoodwinked several experienced collectors.
entries.zh: 这份假邀请函骗过了几位经验丰富的收藏家。

entries.en: The historian traced changing attitudes toward usury.
entries.zh: 历史学家追溯了人们对高利贷态度的变化。

entries.en: The missing contract drew both firms into a legal imbroglio.
entries.zh: 丢失的合同把两家公司都卷入了一场复杂的法律纠纷。

entries.en: She wrote lyrically about the river of her childhood.
entries.zh: 她抒情地描写了童年时的那条河。

entries.en: He secluded himself in a cottage to finish the manuscript.
entries.zh: 他隐居在一间小屋里完成手稿。

entries.en: The unprepossessing building housed a remarkable collection of paintings.
entries.zh: 这栋不起眼的建筑收藏着非凡的画作。

entries.en: The novel contrasts a shiftless son with his industrious mother.
entries.zh: 小说将懒散无为的儿子与勤劳的母亲作了对比。

entries.en: The liquid began to coagulate into soft lumps.
entries.zh: 液体开始凝结成软块。

entries.en: The image shows the coalescence of two small droplets.
entries.zh: 图像显示了两个小液滴的合并。

entries.en: The mistral rattled the shutters throughout the night.
entries.zh: 密史脱拉风整夜吹得百叶窗咔嗒作响。

entries.en: Even the lavish banquet failed to satiate his appetite.
entries.zh: 即使丰盛的宴席也没能满足他的胃口。

entries.en: The octogenarian still led the village choir every Sunday.
entries.zh: 这位八十多岁的老人仍在每个星期日带领村庄合唱团。

entries.en: A mischievous crow filched a spoon from the picnic table.
entries.zh: 一只顽皮的乌鸦从野餐桌上偷走了一把勺子。

entries.en: Unreliable internet remained the project's biggest bugaboo.
entries.zh: 不可靠的网络仍是这个项目最令人头痛的问题。

entries.en: The speech offered plenty of bombast but few concrete ideas.
entries.zh: 演讲充满夸大的空话，却少有具体想法。

entries.en: He regretted his gutless silence when his friend needed support.
entries.zh: 朋友需要支持时，他怯懦地保持沉默，对此他感到后悔。

entries.en: The judgment explains why the lawyer was disbarred.
entries.zh: 判决书解释了这名律师为何被取消执业资格。

entries.en: The magnet separated ferrous fragments from the mixed scrap.
entries.zh: 磁铁从混合废料中分离出了含铁碎片。

entries.en: The study examined how often the animals procreate.
entries.zh: 这项研究考察了这些动物繁殖后代的频率。

entries.en: A zephyr stirred the ribbons tied to the railing.
entries.zh: 一阵微风吹动了系在栏杆上的丝带。

entries.en: The novel moves toward its ineluctable conclusion.
entries.zh: 小说向着不可避免的结局发展。

entries.en: The testimony described acts of bestial cruelty.
entries.zh: 证词描述了野兽般残忍的行为。

entries.en: The diagram identifies the sun's visible surface as the photosphere.
entries.zh: 图中把太阳的可见表面标为光球层。

entries.en: The essay challenges unenlightened attitudes toward unfamiliar cultures.
entries.zh: 这篇文章质疑了对陌生文化的无知态度。

entries.en: The warehouse records showed substantial spoilage during the outage.
entries.zh: 仓库记录显示，停电期间发生了大量变质。

entries.en: The feud sundered friendships that had lasted for decades.
entries.zh: 这场争执拆散了持续数十年的友谊。

entries.en: An aesthete, she chose the kettle for its elegant shape.
entries.zh: 作为唯美主义者，她因水壶造型优雅而选中了它。

entries.en: The printer supplied the concert programs gratis.
entries.zh: 印刷商免费提供了音乐会节目单。

entries.en: It was asinine to blame the rain on the organizer.
entries.zh: 把下雨归咎于组织者是愚蠢的。

entries.en: She copied the intricate pattern with remarkable exactitude.
entries.zh: 她极其精确地复制了复杂的图案。

entries.en: The painted figure was surrounded by a golden aureole.
entries.zh: 画中人物周围有一圈金色光环。

entries.en: The unexpected defeat chastened the boastful team.
entries.zh: 意外的失败使那支自夸的队伍收敛了。

entries.en: The enclosure provides branches for its arboreal inhabitants.
entries.zh: 围场为栖息其中的树栖动物提供了树枝。

entries.en: The model boat began to yaw in the crosswind.
entries.zh: 模型船开始在侧风中偏航。

entries.en: A clamorous crowd gathered outside the locked gates.
entries.zh: 一群喧闹的人聚集在紧锁的大门外。

entries.en: The patient mechanic showed the greenhorn how the parts fitted together.
entries.zh: 耐心的机械师向新手展示了零件如何装配在一起。

entries.en: The lecture lost me in an abstruse discussion of symbolism.
entries.zh: 讲座中深奥难懂的象征主义讨论让我听不明白。

entries.en: The accounts amortize the software cost over several years.
entries.zh: 账目将软件成本在数年内摊销。

entries.en: The columnist inveighed against the demolition of the old library.
entries.zh: 专栏作家猛烈抨击了拆除旧图书馆的行为。

entries.en: The projectionist checked the reel before the audience arrived.
entries.zh: 放映员在观众到来前检查了胶片卷。

entries.en: The biography describes his dissolute years before he returned home.
entries.zh: 传记描述了他回家前放荡的岁月。

entries.en: The forged letter deceived even normally skeptical people, not just the credulous.
entries.zh: 伪造的信不仅骗过了轻信的人，连平时多疑的人也被骗了。

entries.en: The salesgirl wrapped the bowl in soft paper.
entries.zh: 女售货员用柔软的纸包好了碗。
